<center>
## Books
</center>

:::{style='font-size: 1.1em;'}

[**Shiny App-Packages**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/shiny-app-pkgs/): creating a Shiny application in an R package [[**Repo**](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/shiny-app-pkgs)]

[**ggplot2: field manual**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/fm-ggp2/): a field manual for building common (and less common) graphs with `ggplot2` [[**Repo**](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/fm-ggp2)]


[**Posit Admin Development**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/posit-admin-dev/) (**in development**): a field guide for administering Posit Workbench, Connect, and Package Manager on Linux, with notes for regulated (GxP) environments

[**DevOps for Data Science: Lab Solutions**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/do4ds-labs/) (**in development**): Twelve labs covering the infrastructure and deployment side of data science: versioning models with `vetiver`, building APIs with FastAPI and `plumber2`, logging, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS, SSH, Linux user management, instance sizing, and accessibility. [[**Repo**](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/do4ds-labs)]

[**Shiny for Python App-Packages**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/shiny-py-pkgs/) (**in development**): building Shiny for Python applications as Python packages [[**Repo**](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/shiny-py-pkgs)]

[**Personal Finance: a field manual**](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/fm-finance/) (**in development**): a working reference for the day to day decisions that shape your financial life: budgeting, savings, borrowing, investing, taxes, insurance, and planning (with code examples in R and Python) [[**Repo**](https://github.com/mjfrigaard/fm-finance)]

:::
